item.title: Meal - Air Fryer Chicken Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 600g
  • Rice - 2 cups cooked
  • Tortillas - 4
  • Cheese - 1 cup
  • Beans - 1 can
  • Salsa - 1/2 cup
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Paprika

Directions

  1. Cook and season chicken, then shred
  2. Mix with rice, beans and salsa
  3. Fill tortillas and roll tightly
  4. Air fry at 190°C for 10–12 mins until crispy

Macros

  • Calories - 610
  • Protein - 48g
  • Carbs - 55g
  • Fat - 20g

item.title: Meal - Beef Bulgogi Burrito
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g steak, very thinly sliced
  • 1 onion, grated
  • 1 Asian pear, grated
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce
  • ¼ cup brown sugar
  • 1 tsp sesame oil
  • 2 garlic cloves, grated
  • 2cm ginger, grated
  • 2 tbsp gochujang
  • 1 tbsp sesame seeds
  • 4 large burrito wraps
  • Cooked rice
  • Kimchi
  • Sliced spring onion
  • Kewpie mayonnaise

Directions

  1. Mix beef with onion, pear, soy, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, gochujang and sesame seeds.
  2. Marinate for at least 2 hours.
  3. Stir-fry the beef in batches over high heat for 2–3 minutes.
  4. Layer rice, kimchi, beef, mayonnaise and spring onion on each wrap.
  5. Roll tightly and toast in a dry pan or sandwich press.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Chicken Bacon Ranch Burrito
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 1.3kg chicken breast
  • Taco seasoning
  • 500g low-fat cottage cheese
  • 2 tbsp ranch seasoning
  • 1 tsp chipotle in adobo
  • Juice of ½ lime
  • 2 garlic cloves
  • 45ml light mayonnaise
  • 200g light mozzarella
  • 8 bacon rashers, cooked and diced
  • Chives
  • 1kg cooked rice
  • 10 large tortillas

Directions

  1. Season and cook the chicken, then dice it.
  2. Blend cottage cheese, ranch seasoning, chipotle, lime, garlic and mayonnaise until smooth.
  3. Combine chicken with the ranch sauce, mozzarella, bacon and chives.
  4. Warm each tortilla, add rice and chicken filling, then roll tightly.
  5. Toast immediately or wrap and freeze for later.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Grilled Cheese Burrito
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g beef mince
  • Taco seasoning
  • 1 cup cooked seasoned rice
  • 1 cup grated cheddar, plus extra for grilling
  • 1 cup queso or nacho cheese sauce
  • ¼ cup chipotle sauce
  • 1 cup sour cream
  • Crushed tortilla strips
  • 8 large tortillas

Directions

  1. Brown the beef, add taco seasoning and cook until the sauce has reduced.
  2. Layer beef, rice, queso, cheddar, chipotle sauce, sour cream and tortilla strips on each wrap.
  3. Roll tightly into burritos.
  4. Scatter cheese in a hot non-stick pan and place each burrito seam-side down over it.
  5. Turn once the cheese forms a golden crust and toast the other side.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - High Protein Breakfast Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Large tortillas - 10
  • Eggs - 12–14
  • Lean ground meat (beef/turkey/chicken) - 800g–1kg
  • Potatoes or hash browns - 600–800g
  • Cheese - 2 cups (shredded)
  • Oil - 1 tbsp

Seasoning

  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Paprika
  • Garlic powder

Directions

  1. Cook potatoes or hash browns until crispy, then set aside
  2. Cook lean meat with seasoning until browned
  3. Scramble eggs in a large pan
  4. Combine eggs, meat, and potatoes
  5. Lay out tortillas and evenly distribute filling
  6. Add cheese on top
  7. Roll tightly into burritos
  8. Optional: toast in pan or wrap for meal prep storage

Macros

  • Calories - 550
  • Protein - 59g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 18g

Notes

  • Confirmed from reel caption (≈59g protein per burrito) :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}
  • Designed for bulk prep (≈10 servings)
  • Freezes well and reheats easily

item.title: Meal - High Protein Chicken Sausage Breakfast Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken sausage - 4 links (sliced)
  • Eggs - 6
  • Egg whites - 500ml (approx 16 oz)
  • Low-fat cottage cheese - 1/2 cup
  • Large tortillas - 6
  • Cheese - 1–1.5 cups (shredded)
  • Oil spray

Seasoning

  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Garlic powder
  • Paprika

Directions

  1. Cook chicken sausage in a pan until browned
  2. In a bowl, whisk eggs, egg whites, and cottage cheese together
  3. Pour mixture into pan and scramble until fully cooked
  4. Combine eggs with cooked sausage
  5. Lay out tortillas and evenly distribute filling
  6. Add shredded cheese on top
  7. Roll tightly into burritos
  8. Optional: toast lightly or store for meal prep

Macros

  • Calories - 500
  • Protein - 50g
  • Carbs - 40g
  • Fat - 14g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed ingredient list (chicken sausage + egg whites + cottage cheese) :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}
  • Leaner, higher-protein version of breakfast burritos
  • Ideal for batch cooking and freezing

item.title: Meal - High Protein Grilled Cheese Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 900g extra-lean beef mince
  • ½ white onion, diced
  • 4 garlic cloves, minced
  • Taco seasoning
  • 400g canned diced tomatoes
  • 250ml chicken stock
  • 100g light cheddar
  • 600g cooked rice
  • Coriander
  • 6 large tortillas
  • 1 tbsp nacho cheese sauce per burrito
  • 20g light mozzarella per burrito

Directions

  1. Brown onion, garlic and beef, then add taco seasoning, tomatoes and stock.
  2. Simmer until the mixture is thick, then stir through cheddar and coriander.
  3. Divide rice, beef filling and nacho cheese sauce between tortillas and roll tightly.
  4. Place mozzarella in a hot non-stick pan and set the burrito on top.
  5. Cook until the cheese forms a crust, then turn and toast the other side.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Lasagne Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 1 tortilla wrap
  • 4 tbsp bolognese
  • 1 fresh lasagne sheet, or a dried sheet cooked for 5 minutes
  • 2 tbsp béchamel sauce
  • Handful of grated cheese and mozzarella

Directions

  1. Place the wrap flat and layer 2 tbsp bolognese, half the lasagne sheet, 1 tbsp béchamel and cheese.
  2. Repeat the layers once.
  3. Fold into a burrito and wrap it in foil.
  4. Air-fry at 180°C for 10 minutes.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Nacho Cheese Beef Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 1kg lean beef mince
  • 1 red onion, diced
  • 1 green capsicum, diced
  • 1 red capsicum, diced
  • 1 packet taco seasoning
  • 130g low-sugar ketchup
  • 150ml water
  • 230ml light evaporated milk
  • 180g Mexican cheese blend
  • 30ml hot sauce
  • 6 large tortillas

Directions

  1. Brown the beef with onion and capsicum.
  2. Add taco seasoning, ketchup and water, then simmer until thick.
  3. Warm evaporated milk gently, add cheese and hot sauce, and stir until smooth.
  4. Divide beef and cheese sauce between tortillas.
  5. Roll into burritos and toast seam-side down.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Pepper Jack Chicken Burrito
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 900g chicken breast
  • Taco seasoning
  • 200g reduced-fat cheddar
  • 200g reduced-fat mozzarella
  • 14 slices centre-cut bacon, cooked
  • 1 can diced green chillies
  • 8 large tortillas

Directions

  1. Season and cook the chicken, then chop or shred it.
  2. Combine chicken, bacon, green chillies, cheddar and mozzarella.
  3. Divide between warmed tortillas and roll into burritos.
  4. Toast seam-side down until sealed and golden.
  5. Wrap and refrigerate or freeze extras for meal prep.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Spicy Steak & Cheese Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 16 low-carb wraps
  • 900g lean steak
  • Reduced-fat cheese
  • 800g cooked rice
  • Salt and black pepper
  • Paprika, garlic powder and cumin
  • Coriander
  • Onion and capsicum

Sauce

  • 300g fat-free Greek yoghurt
  • 70g light sour cream
  • 50g chipotle in adobo
  • Juice of ½ lime

Directions

  1. Season and cook the steak, then slice or chop it.
  2. Sauté the onion and capsicum until tender.
  3. Blend or stir together the yoghurt, sour cream, chipotle and lime.
  4. Divide rice, steak, vegetables, cheese and sauce between wraps.
  5. Roll tightly and toast, or wrap and freeze for meal prep.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe
